Subject: Headcount approval request — Sales & Solutions offers and comp band guidance (Q3 ramp)

Hi team,

Requesting approval to move forward with a targeted hiring + offer plan to support our Q3 ramp. Summary below and full packet attached (q3_hc_bands_v3.xlsx, hc_request_summary_Q3.pdf). Ask: please approve headcount + proposed comp bands and any exceptions by EOD Monday 6/07 so TA can issue offers.

Quick summary (start dates targeted: early July onward):
- Sales: 3 AE hires (EMEA/US split), 6 SDRs (US-heavy) — propose OTE bands: AE base 110k–135k, OTE 200k–260k; SDR base 55k–70k, OTE 90k–120k.
- Solutions Engineering: 2 Senior SEs to support enterprise pipeline; band: base 150k–170k, total comp 170k–195k.
- Headcount ask: 11 new FTEs (6 SDR, 3 AE, 2 SE).
- Budget impact: incremental run rate ~ $2.5M annualized fully ramped (details in attached spreadsheet).

Notes / asks:
1) Approve the comp bands and allow up to two targeted band exceptions for high-priority candidates with approval flow (Marissa -> Ben -> Finance).
2) Approve the headcount as a single authorization and allow regional rebalancing (Marissa to confirm EU/US split).
3) Karthik, please confirm whether two SEs can be hired as senior ICs versus manager-track — affects comp and hiring pipeline.

If we have approval, TA will proceed with offers for three AE candidates (one requires a comp exception) and pipeline outreach for SDR batch. Recruitr Talent is standing by to issue offer letters.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Director, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Stephanie — great write-up. A few quick asks before we sign off:

- Can you split the HC ask by region (US / EMEA / APAC) in the spreadsheet? Need to see where the 6 SDRs will be placed; if most are US, we may need to pull one from the EMEA allocation.
- For the AE comp exception candidate (AE-123), include a short candidate packet (role fit + counteroffer history) — I see a placeholder in the attachments but need the candidate summary to understand justification.
- We also should define ramp quotas for new AEs/SEs (first 6 months) — suggest a soft quota of 50% in month 1–3, full quota by month 6.

If we get the regional split and candidate packet by EOD, I'm comfortable approving the headcount and standard bands. For exceptions, route to Ben for final sign-off.
